summary: All 42 source hashes and sizes matched, and all 10 proposed computations reproduced. All six libraries registered as normal glucose match the published high-glucose sheet. Their actual glucose exposure remains unresolved, so `needs_author_contact` is justified. The corrected proposal passed the ledger validator. Fresh publisher downloads returned HTTP 403, so I verified the retained XML and supplement. [GEO record](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE275887) · [Published study](https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/15/23/12391)
openIssues: A plate-to-library key is needed to establish glucose exposure and identify the original N3_2 file. Its 3,636,609 assigned gene counts are recoverable, while both MO21 and MO23 deposited files match N2_3.
Figure 2 and Supplementary File S1 agree on 17 normal-glucose and 16 high-glucose calls. Figure 5 and the discussion report 18 in each group.
Independent culture replication remains undocumented, and GEO and the paper name different RNA library-preparation kits.
